description: Reorder pages in a loaded PDF document. Remaps all takeoff sheet keys so measurements and annotations follow their pages. Output file path is optional (default: "<file>_reordered.pdf"); pass overwrite:true to allow replacing an existing file. Coordinates are image px at render scale 2.0: PDF pt × 2, origin top-left, y down (the browser canvas's native space). Sheet payloads carry dims in both px and pt.

order.description: 1-based new page order, e.g. [2, 1, 3] to swap pages 1 and 2

overwrite.description: Replace the file at path even when it is not an OpenTakeoff export. Off by default: re-exporting over a previous export of your own already overwrites without this, so you only need it to deliberately destroy an unrelated file.

name: reorder_pages
